integrity: A complete proof, source comparisons, and an independent-of-formula exact finite checker are embedded; finite runs corroborate but do not establish the general proof.
scientific_limitations: The explicit counting formula concerns finite group actions on flat semilattices with at least two atoms.
Ordinary inverse-semigroup congruences not preserving the maximal-class operation are not classified.
The original full text of the 2015 structural article of Huang and Li was not accessible through the available lawful source route; residual historical-priority risk remains.
title: Complete \(F\)-congruence lattices of flat semilattice actions
